platform: Arch Linux, Omarchy 4.5.0-3, Hyprland 0.56.2, Quickshell 0.3.2 (r7), one 2560x1600 monitor at scale 2, horizontal bar. cronward from its main branch of 2026-11-04 (reports 0.1.0) on the viewer and the main machine. omarchy restart shell, after each change to Cronward.qml

results: Portable checks (26 tests) and the Omarchy validator pass.

Set up with agent: the agent listed the repos the token reaches, put a private test repo's workflow on cronward through cronward --on, and its test run passed. The row appeared in the widget, and its link opened the run on GitHub.
The job's next hourly slot ran on schedule and passed, in the widget.
Ask agent, on a run made to fail on purpose: the agent found the cause from the commit and the run times, said it did not matter, and changed nothing without asking.
Config opened the main machine's config in an editor, in a terminal. Token opened GitHub's token page.
Omarchy 4.5.0 bar: the count shows beside the glyph at full size, in red (failed) and orange (didn't run, a token), after the fix in 1afb3db.
The account key button shows beside a missing or expiring token (demo/run, fictional data). Not clicked: it would run token set on the fictional host.
A theme switch: the widget followed the new theme.
A vertical bar: the icon shows without the count, as designed (no room; the tooltip says it), in the same colour as on a horizontal bar. The user's other bar plugins do the same.
Three monitors (Omarchy 4.0.6): the widget shows on each monitor's bar, and the popup opens below the button on the monitor it was opened from.
Omarchy 4.0.6, without labelText: the count and the running mark are drawn in text beside a full-size glyph, on all three monitors, as the shell's other counts are.
On 2026-11-04, on Omarchy 4.0.6: Check now over IPC ran cronward watch and moved 'as of' forward, and every fixture state, plus not set up and error, rendered distinct (demo/run).
limitations: Not yet tried: the running mark in the bar on Omarchy 4.5.0 (seen on 4.0.6).
